name: light-hub
description: Every working workflow at Light: one plugin per team plus a shared core. Written once in the open Agent Skills and Agent Plugins formats; packaged for each AI platform Light uses.

plugins.name: light-core
plugins.description: For everyone at Light: find a workflow, request one, publish your own, and the company facts every workflow shares.

plugins.name: light-sales
plugins.description: For AEs, BDRs, account managers, solutions engineers and Country Executives: account research, call follow-up, deal review and RFP answers.

plugins.name: light-partners
plugins.description: For the partnerships team: partner referral intake and routing.

plugins.name: light-customer-success
plugins.description: For implementation, data migration, agentic customer engineering and support: go-live checks and help article updates.

plugins.name: light-marketing
plugins.description: For product, growth and regional marketing: localising Light's story and campaigns for each market.

plugins.name: light-people
plugins.description: For Talent Partners and hiring managers: interview scorecards for Ashby.

plugins.name: light-finance
plugins.description: For Finance and anyone asking Finance: pricing approval memos. Draft, not yet distributed.
